vetSays.line: 🛡️ Sandra, Hudson, Manuel, Pilar and Arul met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Sandra, Hudson, Manuel, Pilar, Arul are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Hudson, Manuel, Pilar, Arul and Daniyar met them at the door — 4 put down. Pilar didn't come back. Hudson, Manuel, Arul, Daniyar are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hudson, Arul and Marcus met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Hudson, Arul, Marcus are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Arul just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Marcus — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Marcus chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Marcus and Jesse met them at the door — 2 put down. Marcus, Jesse are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Manuel was ready to hunt Buffering — but the fire says that kind is already put down. The hunt turns to Spool instead."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Marcus Webb, 41 — an electrician. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, Phoenix Clause, Feast Engine, Scream Cheese, Symbiote.
